## PGFX Studio LTX 2.3 Image-First Music Video

Flow: source audio -> ~5s segmentation -> screenplay -> Creator-derived character/theme -> Director prompts -> Z-Image still render -> LTX 2.3 GGUF i2v two-stage -> scene clip export -> final stitch to master audio.

Saved defaults in this workflow:
- 3060 / 12GB oriented best-effort profile
- 1024x576 framing for stills and scene video
- 25fps timing
- ~5s scene chunks
- hard cuts by default; use dedicated transition shots when the story needs a bridge
- project-scoped `lyrics_subtitles.srt`, `creator_schedule.json`, and `word_timing.json` saves

Use `Lyrics Creator` for:
- instruction/context
- audio file + lyrics file
- multiple source images (connect 1-3 here; duplicate if you want more)

Current model/loading policy:
- Still-image branch defaults to `Z-Image/z-image-turbo-fp8-e5m2.safetensors` + `qwen_3_4b.safetensors` + `Flux/ae.safetensors`
- Video branch defaults to `ltx2.3/ltx-2.3-22b-dev-Q4_K_M.gguf` + `gemma_3_12B_it_fp4_mixed.safetensors` + `ltx2.3/ltx-2.3-22b-dev_embeddings_connectors.safetensors`
- LTX 2.3 VAEs default to `ltx2.3/ltx-2.3-22b-dev_audio_vae.safetensors` and `ltx2.3/ltx-2.3-22b-dev_video_vae.safetensors`
- Spatial upscale defaults to `ltx2.3/ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.0.safetensors`

Retry/fallback policy:
- no automatic scene retries by default
- if a scene is weak, rerender that scene before changing the story plan
